name: Vector Workflows
description: A one-person studio that sets up websites, WhatsApp bots, missed-call responders and small automations for local service businesses, with prices in the open.
_google_site_verification: Search Console's HTML-tag check for https://vectorworkflows.com/, written into every page's head. Removing it unverifies the property.

service_groups.name: Get found
service_groups.line: So people searching for what you do find you, and can reach you in one tap.

services.name: Business website
services.line: A fast, hand-built website that tells people what you do and gets them calling or messaging you.
points: Hand-built and quick to open on any phone
Free hosting, with your domain included for year one
Call, WhatsApp and directions buttons on every page
Pairs with Google Business Profile and WhatsApp Business setup as the Starter pack

services.name: Google Business Profile setup
services.line: Your business shows up properly on Google Search and Maps, with the right details.
points: Correct categories, services and opening hours
Your photos added and in order
Your review link, plus a printable review QR code

services.name: WhatsApp Business setup
services.line: Your WhatsApp looks and works like a business number, not a personal one.
points: A catalogue of what you sell or offer
Greeting and away messages, quick replies and labels
A click-to-chat link and a QR code for your counter or card

service_groups.name: Never miss a customer
service_groups.line: Every call and message gets an answer, even when you're busy with the one in front of you.

services.name: WhatsApp auto-reply bot
services.line: Answers the questions you get every day on WhatsApp, at any hour.
points: Replies to common questions about prices, hours and location
Takes booking requests and passes them to you to confirm
Hands the chat over to you when a person is needed

services.name: Missed-call responder
services.line: When you can't pick up, the caller gets a message back straight away.
points: An instant message back to every missed caller
An alert to you with their number
Every call logged in one sheet

services.name: IVR phone line
services.line: A "Press 1 for…" menu that sends each caller to the right place.
points: A short menu in your business's own words
Each option routed to the right person or number
A clear message for callers outside your hours

services.name: Enquiry tracker
services.line: Every enquiry from your website, WhatsApp and calls in one sheet you can work through.
points: Website, WhatsApp and call enquiries in one Google Sheet
A status on each enquiry, so nothing is forgotten
Follow-up reminders for anything still open

service_groups.name: Run smoother
service_groups.line: The small repeat jobs of the week, done the same way every time without you chasing them.

services.name: Appointment reminders
services.line: Customers book a slot and get reminded on WhatsApp, so fewer of them miss it.
points: A booking link for your website, WhatsApp and social profiles
A WhatsApp reminder before each appointment
Bookings land in your own calendar

services.name: Job & site log
services.line: Staff send a photo and a note on WhatsApp, and it becomes a timestamped record.
points: For site issues, deliveries, stock received and proof of finished work
Each message becomes a dated row with the photo attached
One sheet to check instead of scrolling back through chats

services.name: Repeat-customer tracker
services.line: Shows who hasn't come back in a while and sends them a gentle WhatsApp nudge.
points: Customers listed by when they last came in
A friendly WhatsApp message to the ones who are overdue
Written in your words, sent from your business number

services.name: Review requester
services.line: After a visit, the customer receives your Google review link.
points: Sent on WhatsApp after each visit
One tap from the message to your Google review page
Sent at a time you choose, not in the middle of the visit

services.name: Telegram team bot
services.line: One Telegram bot for your staff: tasks, alerts and notes in the chat they already use.
points: Tasks handed out and marked done from Telegram
Alerts when something needs someone's attention
Notes saved where the whole team can find them

systems.name: Missed Lead Responder
systems.line: A missed call becomes an instant SMS reply, an owner alert and a logged lead.
systems.stack: Twilio · FastAPI · MongoDB · Telegram · Google Sheets

systems.name: Site Fault Tracker
systems.line: A WhatsApp photo and a short note become one structured row in the team's sheet.
systems.stack: WhatsApp Cloud API · Python · Vision model · Google Sheets

systems.name: Dynamic Scheduler
systems.line: Send /awake and your day is planned from that moment, shaped by how early or late you woke up.
systems.stack: Telegram Bot API · Python · Google Calendar

_builds: Websites, shown first on Work and home. status is shown exactly as written. specs are measured, never estimated: measured says how and when. A build with case: true has a case study page at url; the others link straight to the site.

builds.name: Auto Detailing & PPF Flagship
builds.teaser: A 3D car to turn, a coverage switcher, a tint previewer and a three-step booking request.
builds.status: Flagship Preview · Ready for Client Launch
builds.line: A seven-page site for a paint protection and ceramic studio: a 3D car to turn and repaint, a coverage switcher, a tint shade previewer and a three-step booking request.
builds.measured: Lighthouse 12, desktop preset, on the preview build, 23 October 2026. Code is gzipped HTML, CSS and JS; the 3D car (1.4 MB) loads only where the device can run it.

builds.name: Cut Above
builds.teaser: An unsolicited salon redesign: a price list you can search, the team and the gallery.
builds.line: An unsolicited redesign for a long-established hair and beauty salon: a price list you can search, the team, the gallery and a booking request. Static pages, no page builder.
builds.measured: Lighthouse 12, desktop preset, 23 October 2026. Code is gzipped HTML, CSS and JS; the salon's photographs come on top.

builds.name: Reliance Coaching Centre
builds.teaser: An enquiry-first site in English and Hindi for the centre where Sam taught.
builds.line: An enquiry-first site for the neighbourhood coaching centre where Sam taught in 2023. Parents see what's taught and reach the centre on WhatsApp in one tap, in English or Hindi.
builds.measured: Lighthouse 12, desktop preset, on the preview build, 23 October 2026. Code is gzipped HTML, CSS and JS; the three font files that carry the Hindi add 203 kB.
